Keri Lynn Hilson (born December 5, 1982) is an American singer-songwriter and actress.
Born and raised in Decatur, Georgia, she began her musical career as a songwriter and backing vocalist for other artists under the wing of record producer Anthony Dent in 2002.
At the age of 14, Hilson secured a record deal with the girl group D'Signe, who disbanded without any releases.
